requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The Out-Of-Box Experience (OOBE) for 123.hp.com must use only one product reference name for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series, to reduce user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must be capable of reliably operating with all new and current Evaluation Media (EM) and market segment media types, meeting the minimum print quality (PQ) standard for each target region.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The product must function correctly and without hardware failures when placed and operated on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer should be assessed for functional failures when tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must be able to print without print quality (PQ) issues when placed on a trolley.
